Roast, brew and bring it home

A small roastery that sells whole beans and brews them in the shop. Choose a bag, pick a grind, and it ships on the day it was roasted.

See the beans

How a roast day goes

Beans arrive green and are sorted by hand. Each batch is roasted to a profile written down beforehand, cooled, and bagged within the hour.

Why batches stay small

A small drum lets us stop a roast within seconds of the colour we want, so every bag in a batch tastes alike.

Visit the shop

Open the door, say what you like to drink, and we will make it. The menu is short on purpose.
